```python
# 5th-order Butterworth lowpass, fc ~ 940 kHz.
# Two unity-gain Sallen-Key biquads (Q=1.618, Q=0.618) followed by a passive RC pole at vout.
# Each SK buffer is a 2-stage Miller OTA: 5T pair (M1 inverting, M2 non-inverting),
# pfet diode/mirror load, nfet common-source M5, pfet current source M6, Miller Cc.
# Predictions come from a 9-node nodal model (finite A(s), output resistance, device caps).

PARAMS = {
    "fc_t":    (940e3, 925e3, 955e3),          # target cutoff (Hz)
    "C2":      (0.15e-12, 0.10e-12, 0.5e-12),  # physical SK grounded caps
    "C_rc":    (10e-12, 3e-12, 30e-12),        # output RC capacitor
    "gmid_in": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),             # input-pair gm/Id
    "gmid_ld": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),              # pfet load/mirror gm/Id
    "gmid_2":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),              # 2nd-stage nfet gm/Id
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),
    "L_ld":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "L_2":     (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),
    "Itail":   (20e-6, 10e-6, 25e-6),          # per-OTA tail current
    "I2":      (50e-6, 25e-6, 48e-6),          # per-OTA 2nd-stage current
    "Cc":      (0.8e-12, 0.3e-12, 2.5e-12),    # Miller compensation
}

LB = 0.5                                                  # bias mirror length
VDD = 1.8
Q1 = 1.0 / (2.0 * abs(math.cos(math.radians(108.0))))    # 1.618
Q2 = 1.0 / (2.0 * abs(math.cos(math.radians(144.0))))    # 0.618


def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)

    # ---- device sizing from design intent ----
    ref_n = lut.size("n", 10.0, LB, iref, vds=0.65)                 # ibias diode
    tail = lut.size("n", 10.0, LB, p["Itail"], vds=0.2)             # tail mirror
    ref_p = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], iref, vds=1.0)   # pb diode
    m_in = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], p["Itail"] / 2, vds=0.6)
    m_ld = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], p["Itail"] / 2, vds=1.0)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_2"], p["L_2"], p["I2"], vds=0.9)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], p["I2"], vds=0.9)

    # ---- SK values (equal R1=R2) ----
    # The gate cap of M2 lands on the b-node, so it is absorbed into C2t.
    w0 = 2.0 * math.pi * p["fc_t"]
    C2t = p["C2"] + m_in.cgg

    def sk(Q):
        C1 = 4.0 * Q * Q * C2t
        R = 1.0 / (w0 * math.sqrt(C1 * C2t))
        return R, C1

    R1a, C1a = sk(Q1)
    R1b, C1b = sk(Q2)
    Crc = p["C_rc"]
    Rrc = 1.0 / (w0 * (Crc + cl))          # RC pole at w0 with the load CL on vout

    # ---- small-signal OTA model ----
    gm_in, gds_in, gds_ld = m_in.gm, m_in.gds, m_ld.gds
    gm5, gds5, gds6 = m5.gm, m5.gds, m6.gds
    Adc = (gm_in / (gds_in + gds_ld)) * (gm5 / (gds5 + gds6))
    Go = gds5 + gds6
    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Cn = m5.cgg + m_ld.cgg
    Cout_dev = m5.cdd + m6.cdd + m_in.cgg

    def poles(CL):
        CLt = CL + Cout_dev
        wp1 = gm_in / (Cc * Adc)
        wp2 = gm5 * Cc / (Cn * CLt + Cc * (Cn + CLt))
        return wp1, wp2

    wp1a, wp2a = poles(C1a)
    wp1b, wp2b = poles(C1b)
    G1a, G1b, Grc = 1.0 / R1a, 1.0 / R1b, 1.0 / Rrc

    def H(f):
        s = 1j * 2.0 * math.pi * f
        D1 = (1 + s / wp1a) * (1 + s / wp2a)
        D2 = (1 + s / wp1b) * (1 + s / wp2b)
        A = np.zeros((9, 9), dtype=complex)
        bv = np.zeros(9, dtype=complex)
        # unknowns: 0 va1, 1 vb1, 2 vi1, 3 vo1, 4 va2, 5 vb2, 6 vi2, 7 vo2, 8 vout
        A[0, 0] = 2 * G1a + s * C1a; A[0, 1] = -G1a; A[0, 3] = -s * C1a; bv[0] = G1a
        A[1, 0] = -G1a;              A[1, 1] = G1a + s * C2t
        A[2, 1] = -Adc;              A[2, 2] = D1;    A[2, 3] = Adc
        A[3, 0] = -s * C1a;          A[3, 2] = -Go;   A[3, 3] = Go + s * C1a + G1b; A[3, 4] = -G1b
        A[4, 3] = -G1b;              A[4, 4] = 2 * G1b + s * C1b; A[4, 5] = -G1b; A[4, 7] = -s * C1b
        A[5, 4] = -G1b;              A[5, 5] = G1b + s * C2t
        A[6, 5] = -Adc;              A[6, 6] = D2;    A[6, 7] = Adc
        A[7, 4] = -s * C1b;          A[7, 6] = -Go;   A[7, 7] = Go + s * C1b + Grc; A[7, 8] = -Grc
        A[8, 7] = -Grc;              A[8, 8] = Grc + s * (Crc + cl)
        x = np.linalg.solve(A, bv)
        return x[8]

    # ---- predictions ----
    f = np.logspace(3, 8, 4000)
    mag = np.array([abs(H(fi)) for fi in f])
    H0 = abs(H(1.0))
    peaking_db = 20.0 * math.log10(mag.max() / H0)

    target = H0 / math.sqrt(2.0)
    below = np.where(mag <= target)[0]
    if len(below) == 0 or below[0] == 0:
        fc = float("nan")
    else:
        i = below[0]
        m1, m2 = mag[i - 1], mag[i]
        t = (math.log(target) - math.log(m1)) / (math.log(m2) - math.log(m1))
        fc = 10 ** (math.log10(f[i - 1]) + t * (math.log10(f[i]) - math.log10(f[i - 1])))

    atten_db = -20.0 * math.log10(abs(H(10.0 * fc)) / H0) if fc == fc else float("nan")
    power = VDD * (2 * iref + 2 * (p["Itail"] + p["I2"]))

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: ibias diode, pb = pfet diode fed by iref plus nfet sink
    n.dev("MBN", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ref_n)
    n.dev("MBN2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ref_n)
    n.dev("MBP", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", ref_p)

    for k in (1, 2):
        vo, b, t = f"vo{k}", f"b{k}", f"tail{k}"
        nd, n1 = f"nd{k}", f"n1_{k}"
        n.dev(f"MT{k}", t, "ibias", "vss", "vss", tail)
        n.dev(f"M1_{k}", nd, vo, t, "vss", m_in)        # gate on feedback node (inverting side)
        n.dev(f"M2_{k}", n1, b, t, "vss", m_in)         # gate on signal node (non-inverting side)
        n.dev(f"M3_{k}", nd, nd, "vdd", "vdd", m_ld)    # diode load
        n.dev(f"M4_{k}", n1, nd, "vdd", "vdd", m_ld)
        n.dev(f"M5_{k}", vo, n1, "vss", "vss", m5)
        n.dev(f"M6_{k}", vo, "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
        n.C(f"CC{k}", n1, vo, Cc)

    # SK1 (Q=1.618): vin -R- a1 -R- b1 ; C1: a1-vo1 ; C2: b1-vss
    n.R("R1a", "vin", "a1", R1a)
    n.R("R2a", "a1", "b1", R1a)
    n.C("C1a", "a1", "vo1", C1a)
    n.C("C2a", "b1", "vss", p["C2"])
    # SK2 (Q=0.618): vo1 -R- a2 -R- b2 ; C1: a2-vo2 ; C2: b2-vss
    n.R("R1b", "vo1", "a2", R1b)
    n.R("R2b", "a2", "b2", R1b)
    n.C("C1b", "a2", "vo2", C1b)
    n.C("C2b", "b2", "vss", p["C2"])
    # passive RC pole at output (CL sits on vout externally)
    n.R("Rrc", "vo2", "vout", Rrc)
    n.C("Crc", "vout", "vss", Crc)

    return n, {"fc": fc, "peaking_db": peaking_db, "atten_db": atten_db, "power": power}
```
